prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: widescreen narrative background for an original dark fantasy game. Primary request: regenerate the FIRST reference mine confrontation scene with the correct equipment for all five heroes, preserving the cast, place, story beat, visual identity, clothing and sober cinematic realism.
Reference 1 is the edit target/composition and environment. Reference 2 is Eve's canonical face, short copper-red hair, distressed ivory coat and brass crystal GUN. Reference 3 is Shuo's canonical face/topknot/dark patterned robes and sword. Reference 4 is Gran's bearded face, weathered bronze armor and deep green cloak. Reference 5 is Rin's canonical face, purple hood, dark leather, RIGHT bandaged intact hand, LEFT black glove.
Scene: damp ruined mine gateway and Gothic ruins at night, pale teal crystalline humanoids emerging from tunnel, warm lanterns reflecting in wet stones, moon and ruined architecture. A tense moment of readiness before combat, no injuries or physical contact occurring.
Exactly five party members, same identities as reference 1: Shuo at left, Phosphor child behind Gran, Gran center-left, Rin foreground center and Eve right. Exactly five crystal humanoids beyond them, roughly the source group's placement. Phosphor stays safe behind the armored protector, wearing yellow scarf, empty hands. No sixth hero.
Fix weapons so silhouettes are unmistakable, and adapt arm poses as necessary:
- Shuo holds a single long, narrow, steel sword with antique brass hilt, poised toward the tunnel; no book in his hands.
- Gran braces a LARGE physical shield, weathered dark metal and antique brass edge, broad enough to protect the small child behind him. Shield visible toward the monsters; no glowing energy barrier.
- Rin wears her purple hood. Her LEFT black-gloved hand holds one SHORT steel dagger (blade only about forearm length), not a sword; her RIGHT intact bandaged hand is held close against her torso and does not grip a weapon. Show this anatomically correctly, adjust her angle if needed, no missing hand. Do not give her two weapons.
- Eve holds the distinctive antique brass crystal pistol from reference 2, with a clear hand grip and trigger, short brass barrel and pale amber crystal core. She aims this compact crystal GUN toward the tunnel. No sword, no long blade, no bayonet, no staff, no modern rifle.
Maintain grounded sculptural faces, realistic hand anatomy, weathered metal, restrained dark green/antique gold/teal palette, serious painterly cinematic finish. Balanced horizontal composition, all core weapon silhouettes within frame and above the lowest 20 percent that game dialogue overlays. Reserve top center for UI title with no major face there, keep lighting legible. Target around 1536x864 16:9, no 4K. No text, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Preserve consistent adult faces and costumes and child scale.
